授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
+) Students must register this lecture in Moodle before the first lecture.
+) Use Moodle to contact the instructor and submit assignments.
+) All students have to install Anaconda in their laptop. (Students can borrow an IUP laptop if they do not have one.)

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: To study fundamentals of programming concepts and skills needed for solving real problems using Python.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
"This course is a DX subject for developing DNA (Digital Native in Agriculture) human resources. You can acquire the following digital mind and skills (DMS).
1. You can learn about programming concepts in MATLAB .
2. You can acquire the knowledge and skills to design a computer program solving a real problem.
3. You can learn about using equipments to collect digital data."
